value.rationale: A natural 32-vertex icosahedral-dual polyhedral configuration has a complete exact-degree interpolation invariant. The first full interpolation at degree 17, ten discrete subsequent losses (last at degree 44), and permanent recovery at degree 45 are neither routine small-degree checks nor inferred by a general addition theorem. The exact all-degree statement explains substantive nonmonotonic behavior of interpolation on a symmetric finite sample, beyond known single-orbit harmonic-index cancellations.
